dedupe_keys.name: ei sweden electricity network supply reliability outage indicators per network company 2010 onwards with gis map

description: The Swedish Energy Markets Inspectorate (Ei) publishes statistics on the supply reliability of Swedish electricity networks from the outage reports that network companies submit the year after the outages occur. Companies report for each individual customer connection point, and the full material covers outage data for more than 5.6 million customers, together with withdrawn and injected energy, voltage and industry code per customer. Ei compiles the reports and usually publishes each December; the statistics page gives one Excel file of key outage indicators per year from 2010 to 2024, presented per reporting unit and split into local and regional networks, and a GIS map on ArcGIS that shows supply reliability from 2016 onwards by municipality, by area concession and by reporting unit. Ei uses the data for supervision of supply reliability. Coverage is Sweden. Files are free; Ei states that its open data can be used, reused and shared by anyone without copyright, patent or confidentiality restrictions. Caveats: public files hold aggregated indicators, not the customer-level records, and definitions follow Ei reporting rules explained on the site. Simulation uses are calibration of outage frequency and duration in distribution and regional networks, and resilience benchmarking of network companies. Related records: data-ei-sweden-open-data-energy-network-statistics lists the other Ei data sets.
